name: build_calculator_assets
description: JS tests for the colocated LiveView hooks. No bundler here — assets/js/app.js ships through esbuild (see mix.exs, assets.build/assets.deploy); this package.json exists only so `node --test` has somewhere to install happy-dom from. Deliberately NO "type": "module" — esbuild resolves module type from the nearest package.json for EVERY .js file it bundles, including assets/vendor/topbar.js (plain CommonJS), and "module" here broke `mix esbuild` for that file. All test files use the .mjs extension instead, which Node always parses as ESM regardless of this field.
